text:
incident-bot: SEV2 page: multiple serving pods OOMs in us-west-2 (cluster: prod-west-us). Paging oncall.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert: High error rate + 5 pod restarts in 10m for service=redwood-serving, nodepool=ib-optimized

maya: I saw the page, taking pager. I'll triage. Anyone already seeing kernel/CUDA logs?

jordan: jumping in. pods are restarting with OOMKilled and some CUDA failure logs. Looks correlated to a couple of nodes that show IB rx errors.

maya: thanks. running logs now.

maya: `kubectl -n serving logs -l app=redwood-runtime -c runtime --tail=200`

maya: sample from pod runtime-abc-5:
```
[2026-03-15T12:34:21Z] RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. attempted allocate 1.2GiB (device 0)
[2026-03-15T12:34:22Z] OOM killer invoked for process 12345
[2026-03-15T12:34:25Z] KV cache miss backlog > 500
```

lee: on the infra side, `ibstat` shows link 2 flapping on node ip-10-4-2-17:
```
Link detected: down -> up (x3 in 30s)
port2: state: Active (moving)
rx_err: 12345
```

sam: confirmed. ethtool -S shows high packet retransmits on mlx5_core.

maya: hypothesis: intermittent RDMA packet loss causing retries, amplified latency, async queue growth -> memory pressure -> OOM. Need to isolate nodes and failover.

maya: mitigation plan:
1) cordon node ip-10-4-2-17 and drain non-critical pods
2) scale down batch-size and max-concurrency on serving route to reduce memory per-request
3) promote local model-variant fallback (cpu or smaller quantized) for in-flight requests
4) open customer-impact note to CS

jordan: running cordon: `kubectl cordon ip-10-4-2-17` -> done. draining serving pods now.

ops-bot: drain job started for node ip-10-4-2-17 (pods will be evicted with graceful termination 30s)

maya: scaled down concurrency on route /v1/generate from 8 -> 2 via console API. Reduces concurrent KV caches.

maya: applied config:
```
PATCH /routes/serving/gen
{ "max_concurrency": 2 }
```

sam: infra is rebooting the NIC on the node and replugging IB fabric path to the spine switch. Also setting `mlx5_core` debug counters to collect.

lee: I'm rerouting 3 pods to nodes in another rack that show healthy IB stats. starting rolling restart for affected deployment.

maya: Customer impact: about 18% error rate for gen endpoints in us-west-2 for 10m window. Notified CS to inform top 10 customers likely impacted.

cs-rotations: Received. Drafting message for impacted customers summarizing degraded performance and ongoing mitigation. ETA 15m.

jordan: logs after cordon/drain show fewer OOMs. still seeing occasional CUDA allocation failure but less frequent.

maya: temporary autoscaling policy: increase pod replicas by +30% in healthy nodepool to absorb traffic while flapped nodes are isolated.

ops-bot: autoscaling change applied: serving-deploy -> replicas 40 -> 52

sam: collected ibstats and packet capture, forwarding to vendor (Mellanox) for analysis. Key counters: rx_crc_err, rx_overrun, link flaps.

maya: we're stabilizing. will keep monitoring for 30m before handing off to morning oncall. timeline:
- 12:34 alert received
- 12:36 cordon node ip-10-4-2-17
- 12:40 scale down concurrency
- 12:47 drain/evict pods
- 13:05 NIC reboot & reroute
- 13:22 error rate dropped to 2%

lee: recommending postmortem and config change: add graceful degrade policy to automatically switch to local quantized variants when inter-node latency/packet loss thresholds exceeded.

maya: agreed. assigning postmortem to lee and jordan. CC: sam for infra analysis, cs-rotations for customer comms.

jordan: oncall handoff to night team at 14:00 UTC. leaving notes in incident tracker.

maya: handing off. If symptoms reappear ping me directly. closing pager for now, will update channel with postmortem link when available. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged closed by maya at 1836004820
